x: Andre Johnson was a convincing winner of the short sprint as was fellow Junior Mat George in the high hurdles, and it was nice to welcome a new face to the 400 metre scene - Phil Turner.

Man of the match was Ealing's outstanding sprinter Kevin Mark; our own Marlon Dickson and Adam Daniel both got washed away to 2nd places in his wake but in the 'B' string races all-rounder Geoffrey Ojok and Andre Johnson, competing for us for the first time, both scorched to wins.
There's plenty more to come too, as each of the takeovers was extremely 'safe' and Andre Johnson on last leg took his foot off the gas with the line still 20 metres away.
